polls.description: Widespread technical disruptions affecting Microsoft's email and other applications impacted tens of thousands of users globally, highlighting infrastructure reliability concerns for critical cloud services.
polls.question: Are these outages acceptable for critical business cloud services?

cluster_stories.title: Global Microsoft outage affecting tens of thousands of users
cluster_stories.summary: Microsoft said the outage was caused by servers unexpected becoming unavailable, straining other systems.

cluster_stories.title: Widespread outage hits Microsoft email, other apps
cluster_stories.summary: Nearly 1,30,000 users on outage tracker Downdetector reported problems accessing Outlook just after 1 pm. New reports have since fallen from that peak, but many said they couldn't send and receive emails or had trouble loading their inboxes altogether.
